pricing.description: Measures pricing power — how effectively the business captures value through pricing strategy
pricing.interpretation: Weak pricing health. This loop is a drag on revenue growth — prioritize improvements.

retention.description: Measures customer retention health — how well the business keeps customers and maintains loyalty
retention.interpretation: Excellent retention health. This is a well-tuned revenue engine.

acquisition.interpretation: Good acquisition health with room for improvement. Focus on the weakest component.

expansion.interpretation: Excellent expansion health. This is a well-tuned revenue engine.

matches.name: Low-Margin Services Driving Revenue
matches.description: The highest-revenue services have the lowest margins. Revenue is masking inefficiency — the business is working harder for less profit.
matches.evidence: Low-margin/high-revenue: Process Optimization, Bulk Order, PPC Campaign
matches.recommendation: Audit delivery costs for top revenue services. Consider price increases, scope tightening, or delivery automation for low-margin high-revenue services.

matches.name: No Price Increases Over Time
matches.description: Average transaction value has remained flat or declined over 12+ months, indicating prices haven't kept pace with inflation or value delivered.
matches.recommendation: Implement annual price increases (3-10% depending on market). Consider grandfathering existing clients and raising prices for new business.

matches.name: High Price Variability Without Structure
matches.description: Prices for the same service vary widely (CV > 40%), suggesting inconsistent discounting, ad-hoc pricing, or lack of price governance.
matches.evidence: High price variability in 31 services: Strategy Session, Market Analysis, Implementation Fee
matches.recommendation: Standardize pricing with clear discount governance. Define approval levels for discounts and track discounting patterns by salesperson.

matches.name: Long Gaps Between Purchases
matches.description: Customers have long gaps between purchases (90+ days between transactions), suggesting low engagement and high churn risk.
matches.evidence: At-risk segment: 107 days since last purchase
matches.recommendation: Create re-engagement campaigns for customers who haven't purchased in 60+ days. Consider subscription or retainer models to increase purchase frequency.

matches.name: Scope Creep / Unbilled Work
matches.description: Transactions for the same customer vary significantly in amount, suggesting scope creep, unbilled overages, or inconsistent pricing.
matches.recommendation: Implement clear scope-of-work agreements with change order processes. Track billable vs. non-billable hours. Send mid-project budget updates to clients.
